How it works

Every package published to the Chain Registry is committed into a Merkle tree. The root hash of this tree is anchored to L1 via the bridge, creating an immutable proof of inclusion.

Enter a package canonical (e.g., npm/express@4.18.0) above
The verifier fetches the Merkle proof from the node
Recompute hashes along the proof path using each proof.path[].is_right direction bit
Compare the recomputed root against proof.expected_root and block_header.merkle_root

This verification can be performed by any light client without downloading the full chain.
